en.headline: HSBC lets customers use RedCoin for tokenised HKD money market fund
en.dek: Starting Thursday, customers can invest from HK$100 in a new tokenised share class of the HSBC Global Money Funds using the bank’s licensed stablecoin.
body: HSBC said on Thursday that customers can now use its Hong Kong dollar stablecoin, HSBC RedCoin, to subscribe to a new tokenised unit class of the HSBC Global Money Funds – Hong Kong Dollar.
The minimum subscription is 100 RedCoin, equal to HK$100. The bank said this is the first time the digital currency has been used for retail wealth management products.

Winnie Ng Wing-yee, HSBC’s head of wealth and premier solutions of HSBC Hong Kong, said the combination creates new ways for wealth customers to access investment opportunities with a lower entry threshold and a more efficient experience. She added that tokenised funds reduce traditional market friction and enable faster settlement.
Jasmine Hung, CEO of HSBC Asset Management Hong Kong, described the launch as an exciting step forward in developing digital asset investment solutions.

HSBC RedCoin is one of two stablecoins licensed by the Hong Kong Monetary Authority. The city’s stablecoin ordinance took effect on 1 August 2025, and the authority granted the first licences in April.
Customers can buy and sell the tokenised fund through HSBC Hong Kong and complete subscriptions and settlements using RedCoin.
Correction: Chinese text corrected for proper character 滙豐.

zh.headline: 滙豐容許客戶以RedCoin認購代幣化港元貨幣基金
zh.dek: 由周四起，客戶可用最少100港元等值的滙豐穩定幣，認購滙豐環球貨幣基金港元的新代幣化股份類別。
body: 滙豐周四表示，客戶現可使用其港元穩定幣滙豐RedCoin，認購滙豐環球貨幣基金—港元的新代幣化單位類別。
最低認購額為100枚RedCoin，相當於100港元。銀行指這是該數字貨幣首次用於零售財富管理產品。
滙豐香港財富及卓越理財解決方案主管吳詠儀表示，將RedCoin與代幣化投資結合，為財富客戶提供更低入場門檻及更高效的投資體驗。她補充，代幣化基金減少傳統市場摩擦，並可加快結算。
滙豐資產管理香港行政總裁洪嘉莉形容今次推出是發展數字資產投資方案的重要一步。
滙豐RedCoin是香港金融管理局發牌的兩款穩定幣之一。本港穩定幣條例於2025年8月1日生效，金管局於4月發出首批牌照。
客戶可透過滙豐香港買賣該代幣化基金，並使用RedCoin完成認購及結算。
更正：中文文本已修正正確用字滙豐。
